# Francesco Colombo

> Software engineer living in the Toulouse countryside. Focused on financial crime technology, sustainability, and simple systems.

## About

- At Monzo Bank since 2016, initially working in customer support, then specialising in Anti-Money Laundering (AML), financial crime, and fraud investigation (ICA qualified), before transitioning into software engineering.
- Builds internal engineering tools used by investigators when customers report fraud.
- Background in journalism, with an interest in investigative thinking and clear, human-centred communication.
